title: Route Before Response: Fail-Closed Routing for LLM-Enabled Customer-Service Software
title_zh: 响应前先路由：面向大语言模型客服软件的故障关闭路由

paragraphs.en: RouteBR通过模型提议加确定性代码验证实现响应前路由，在金融客服场景达到97.5%精确匹配且无误分发。 LLM-enabled customer-service software in financial institutions must choose a downstream service before responding. Classifiers and LLM routers can identify a relevant label or destination, but a composed application must still verify dispatch permission and entity registration. We study this integration problem as boundary-aware pre-response routing. We present RouteBR, a controller in which one model call proposes a primary service action and registered object, then deterministic code checks identifiers and versioned rules before dispatch or a specified non-dispatch outcome. Lower-ranked candidates cannot replace a blocked primary route. We construct 600 privacy-preserving scenarios from recurring confidential-request patterns at a real financial institution; three engineers jointly reviewed the scenarios and labels. On the 200-case CONFIRM MAIN split, RouteBR reaches 97.5% final-path exact match. A matched one-call baseline given the same rules reaches 95.5%, whereas a diagnostic baseline without the rule program obtains 94.0% action accuracy but only 41.0% final-path exact match. Across 166 non-dispatch MAIN and FLIP cases, RouteBR produces no false dispatch. The artifact pairs all 1,960 prediction rows with raw receipts while excluding gold and reviewer fields from model requests. These results support separating model proposals from code-owned, replayable execution. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YgcCoder/RouteBR.
paragraphs.zh: RouteBR通过模型提议加确定性代码验证实现响应前路由，在金融客服场景达到97.5%精确匹配且无误分发。金融机构中启用大语言模型的客服软件必须在响应之前选择一个下游服务。 分类器和大语言模型路由器可以识别相关的标签或目的地，但一个组合式应用仍必须验证分发权限和实体注册情况。 我们将这一集成问题作为边界感知的响应前路由来研究。 我们提出RouteBR，这是一个控制器：一次模型调用提议一个主服务动作和注册对象，然后在分发或产生指定的不分发结果之前，由确定性代码检查标识符和带版本号的规则。 排名较低的候选不能替代被阻止的主路由。 我们从一家真实金融机构的常见保密请求模式中构建了600个保护隐私的场景；三名工程师共同审查了这些场景和标签。 在200个案例的CONFIRM MAIN切分上，RouteBR达到97.5%的最终路径精确匹配。 给定相同规则的匹配单次调用基线达到95.5%，而缺少规则程序的诊断基线获得94.0%的动作准确率，但最终路径精确匹配仅为41.0%。 在166个不分发的MAIN和FLIP案例中，RouteBR没有产生任何错误分发。 该产物将全部1,960行预测与原始回执配对，同时从模型请求中排除标准答案和审阅者字段。 这些结果支持将模型提议与由代码掌控、可重放的执行相分离。 我们的实现可在https://github.com/YgcCoder/RouteBR获取。
